documents.title: Emberdeep Game Design and Development Specification

change_log.decision: Expand the showcase overview into implementation and art specifications. Make physical water collection, safe search, animal rescue and deeper sector progression the next development direction.
change_log.implementation_status: Documentation only. No new runtime feature or APK is implied by this revision.
change_log.verification: Baseline source and existing test reports inspected; new mechanics require future implementation and device acceptance.

change_log.decision: Implement M1 manual hydrant and creek supply, exclusive refill input, conserved tank amounts and sector-entry retry; retain the repaired camp menu and standalone route.
change_log.implementation_status: 0.2.0 / Android code 3 M1 candidate with clean Editor rule and interaction regressions. Headset usability and performance are not accepted. M2 search, animals, settlement and durable saves, and M3 sidegrades remain proposed.
change_log.verification: Clean release verification: 119 EditMode and 17 PlayMode passed, zero failed, under Logs/EmberdeepM1/ReleaseVerification. APK status remains separately tracked in ImplementationStatus.json. Worn-headset checks are deferred by user availability; M1DeviceAcceptance.json is the handoff checklist. Word regenerated with structural content verification; new visual rendering remains blocked by unavailable bundled LibreOffice and stalled unlicensed Word export.

change_log.decision: Respond to user-reported unusable hand buttons with visible index-finger rays and same-hand fresh-pinch UI across camp, modals, HUD and shop. Deliver separate editable Blender Art V2 assets and bounded Unity rendering integration while preserving M1 manual supply and stable menu placement.
change_log.implementation_status: 0.2.1 / Android code 4 candidate. The historical positive device confirmation remains front placement only; no headset is connected this iteration. M2 search, animals, settlement and durable saves, and M3 progression remain proposed.
change_log.verification: Current release verification passed 129 EditMode and 30 PlayMode tests with zero failures under Logs/EmberdeepV2/ReleaseVerification. APK scene/settings/hash audits are tracked separately in Logs/EmberdeepV2/ReleaseEvidence.json. All three DOCX regenerated; source-content and hash QA at Logs/EmberdeepV2/Docs/qa.json. Visual document QA remains unavailable: no bundled LibreOffice and historical native Word export stalled while unlicensed; no Word retry or old render is claimed as current evidence.

change_log.decision: Use system hand aim and contextual UI rays; add guided manual refill cues and 12-degree valve-tap tolerance; reuse car hand visuals with interior clipping and pinch-midpoint grip; restore the original soft flame contour.
change_log.implementation_status: 0.2.3 / Android code 6 implemented candidate. M2/M3 and durable saves remain proposed.
change_log.verification: Current 0.2.3 verification passed 142 EditMode and 40 PlayMode tests with zero failures under Logs/EmberdeepPolish/FinalVerification. Both complete left/right scene-wiring cases are included in the 40 passes. Quest and PICO APKs were built with version 0.2.3/code 6, zero errors and exactly the camp/fireground scene whitelist. Both builds restored all 28 audited configuration hashes; 77 verified source and scene files also remained unchanged. Quest 3 installation/version is verified, but STANDBY persisted and no app process was observed after wake/launch requests. Worn-headset acceptance remains pending. Final Word regeneration and exact source-content checks passed; current rendering failed because soffice.exe is unavailable, so Word drafts have no visual layout approval.

change_log.decision: Correct live-hand selection and preserve SDK pose/visibility ownership after confirmed frozen-model device feedback.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; 142 EditMode and 43 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; Quest 0.2.4/code 7 installed; Quest hand-following confirmed by user; other device acceptance pending
change_log.verification: Logs/EmberdeepHandFreeze/Verification; 142 EditMode and 43 PlayMode passed. User confirmed normal hand-model following after New Game on Quest 3 0.2.4 only; other checks pending.

change_log.decision: Freeze the last hand model when Quest palm system controls suppress app tracking. Show contextual full-hand action poses while retaining pinch input. Replace the initial hydrant with a hand-operated well lever; upgrades unlock a rotary hydrant and then one-press automatic filling.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; 156 EditMode and 64 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; Quest 0.2.5/code 8 installed; user confirmed system-menu hand hold/recovery and starter well refill on Quest 3; other device acceptance pending
change_log.verification: Logs/EmberdeepInteractionStages/FinalVerification: 156 EditMode and 64 PlayMode passed. Both APKs audited for version, ARM64, signing, camp/fireground whitelist and restored settings. Editor injected action captures are not headset evidence. Exact DOCX source checks are tracked in Docs/qa.json; Word visual review remains pending renderer availability.

change_log.decision: Explicit user feedback supersedes 0.2.5 bounded wrist correction, pinch-operated starter lever and tool-required pump interaction. Other station tiers, creek and firearm input remain unchanged.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; 167 EditMode and 84 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited. User requested APK delivery only this round; 0.2.6 installation and worn-headset acceptance pending. PICO 4 physical acceptance pending.
change_log.verification: Current 0.2.6 verification: 167 EditMode and 84 PlayMode tests passed. Both APKs passed version, ARM64, signature, standalone scene whitelist and restored-settings audits. User requested APK delivery only this round; 0.2.6 installation and worn-headset acceptance pending. Editor captures use injected SDK samples and actual runtime props. They show stable anchored display contact under wrist rotation and moving lever contact, not physical hand comfort or performance.

change_log.decision: The user reported that the 0.2.6 whole-hand well gesture was unusable and explicitly requested restoring pinch. This is negative device feedback, not acceptance of 0.2.7. Earlier scoped confirmations and test reports remain historical.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.7 / code 10; 167 EditMode and 87 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; installation and worn-headset acceptance PENDING.
change_log.verification: Current 0.2.7 FinalVerification passed 167 EditMode and 87 PlayMode tests, zero failed, skipped or inconclusive. Both APKs passed version 0.2.7/code 10, ARM64, signature, standalone camp/fireground whitelist and settings-restoration audits. Installation and worn-headset acceptance remain pending. See Logs/EmberdeepPinchRestore/ReleaseEvidence.json. Word structural QA is separate from blocked visual rendering.

change_log.decision: The user reported on Quest 0.2.7 that Shop had no highlight and could not be clicked after extinguishing fires. This is a specific negative interaction observation, not acceptance of the rest of the game. Correct per-hand near-source ownership and allow a safe dock-to-Shop transition only in Run.InSupply.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.8 / code 11; 167 EditMode and 92 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; Quest Shop highlight/entry user-confirmed; remaining device checks PENDING.
change_log.verification: Current 0.2.8 FinalVerification passed 167 EditMode and 92 PlayMode tests, zero failed, skipped or inconclusive. The five new Shop cases are included in 92. Both APKs passed version 0.2.8/code 11, ARM64, signature, standalone camp/fireground whitelist and settings-restoration audits. Quest 3 replacement installation, installed version 0.2.8/code 11 and subsequent running app process are verified. The user confirmed that Shop now highlights and opens after firefighting on Quest 3 0.2.8. This accepts only that reported interaction; purchases, all hand/control boundaries, PICO compatibility and performance remain unverified. The earlier Asleep reading is historical. See Logs/EmberdeepShopFix/ReleaseEvidence.json. Current Editor captures use synthetic policy/ray samples. Word structural QA does not establish rendered layout approval.

change_log.decision: On Quest 3 0.2.8 the user confirmed Shop highlights and opens, then reported that the in-game and Shop panels appear near the legs/seat rather than in front. The positive confirmation covers access only; placement remains a negative observation. Separate HUD from Arena and use stable eye-relative front placement; final implementation specification pending.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.9 / code 12; 184 EditMode and 96 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; Quest installation/version verified; current device placement acceptance PENDING.
change_log.verification: Current 0.2.9 FinalVerification passed 184 EditMode and 96 PlayMode tests, zero failed, skipped or inconclusive. The 17 new HUD pose cases and four new PlayMode cases are included in those totals. Both APKs passed version 0.2.9/code 12, ARM64, signature, standalone camp/fireground whitelist and settings-restoration audits. Quest 3 replacement installation preserves data and installed version 0.2.9/code 12 is verified. Launch was requested but is not confirmed: no app PID was observed and the recorded power state is Asleep. Device placement/Shop acceptance remains pending. No PICO 4 physical usability or performance acceptance. Prior 0.2.8 Shop highlight/entry confirmation is historical and does not validate this placement change. See Logs/EmberdeepHudFix/ReleaseEvidence.json. Four Editor synthetic images establish scoped geometry/presentation only. Word content QA does not establish page-layout approval.

change_log.decision: The user partially approved Quest 0.2.9 panel height but requested slightly higher placement. They then clarified that when trying to click a menu, pump or gameplay interactions may trigger, and they are unsure of the exact cause. The primary report is menu intent losing priority to physical/weapon actions, not confirmed accidental UI activation while playing. The second-incident right creek was only a suspected factor. Keep higher HUD/optional creek layout; prioritize explicit UI intent over new physical/weapon acquisition, while preserving an already operating refill hand.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.10 / code 13; 184 EditMode and 115 PlayMode passed; both APKs built/audited; Quest installed; launch not attempted; device testing deferred by user.
change_log.verification: Current ReleaseAcceptance passed 184 EditMode and 115 PlayMode, zero failed, skipped or inconclusive. The 19 additional PlayMode cases are included in 115; the 17 HUD EditMode cases already existed. Both Quest and PICO APKs passed version 0.2.10/code 13, ARM64, signature/icon, camp/fireground scene-whitelist and 28-setting restoration audits. Both builds report zero errors, with 8 Quest warnings and 12 PICO warnings; they are not warning-free builds. Quest 3 replacement installation and app info verified 0.2.10/code 13. The headset was Asleep, no app process was observed, and launch was not attempted. The user explicitly deferred testing until later this round; current placement/menu interaction acceptance remains pending. Do not infer acceptance from old feedback or ask again this round. No PICO 4 physical usability or performance acceptance. Original FinalAcceptance stable-placement SetUp failure remains recorded with unknown root cause; final passing suite did not relax the 10-second threshold.

change_log.decision: User requests very slow automatic water recovery and a visible preview for every purchasable item. Supersede the blanket no-passive-water rule while preserving manual supply and prevention of transition-based water grants. Define shop preview coverage for tools, tuning and station tiers.
change_log.implementation_status: Documentation only. Runtime and installed APK remain 0.2.10 / Android code 13. GD-WATER-10/11, GD-SHOP-01/02 and AR-SHOP-01 are approved direction, not implemented or device accepted. The 0.25 units/second and 3-second delay are starting targets.
change_log.verification: Regenerate Word and compare exact source content in Logs/EmberdeepDesign012/Docs/qa.json. Page rendering is a separate check. Prior 184/115 tests validate 0.2.10 only; no new runtime tests or APK build are claimed.

change_log.decision: Implement the approved 0.12 recovery and shop-preview direction as candidate 0.2.11 / Android code 14. Keep the prior approved design and all version-scoped evidence historical.
change_log.implementation_status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.11 / code 14; FinalVerification passed 204 EditMode and 144 PlayMode, all 12 Editor captures reviewed, Quest/PICO APKs built and audited. Worn-headset usability and performance acceptance pending.
